close_reason:
Applied option 1 (wrap the input): format_receipt_timestamp_at now takes (&UTCDate, &UTCDate) instead of (&UTCDate, DateTime<Utc>). Both parameters are JMAP-native; chrono is no longer in the public signature.

chrono stays a private implementation dependency (still pulls into the build, but it's no longer in this crate's SemVer surface). The no-suffix companion format_receipt_timestamp materialises 'now' internally via Utc::now().to_rfc3339_opts(SecondsFormat::Secs, true) and delegates.

Added regression test 'format_parse_error_on_now' codifying the silent-degradation contract for malformed reference time (returns 'Today' rather than panicking) — matches the existing malformed-dt fallback.

API break: callers passing chrono::Utc::now() must wrap as &UTCDate::from(...rfc3339...). Pre-1.0 so acceptable. Option 2 (feature-gate the helper) is correctly out of scope — the wrap-the-input fix is smaller and equally effective.

cargo test green, clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings clean, RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc clean. Committed as 67e99ec.
description:
File: crate-jmap-chat-client/src/utils.rs:33.

`pub fn format_receipt_timestamp_at(dt: &UTCDate, now: DateTime<Utc>) -> String` takes `chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>` by value. `chrono` is declared as `chrono = { version = "0.4", default-features = false, features = ["std", "clock"] }` in Cargo.toml line 18 — chrono is pre-1.0.

Caller impact:
- A `chrono` 0.4 → 0.5 major bump (or 0.4.x → 0.4.(x+1) compat break) cascades into a breaking signature change here.
- Consumers who don't want a `chrono` dep at all (small WASM builds, dependency minimisation) cannot avoid it: there is no `[features]` table in `Cargo.toml`, so chrono is unconditionally pulled in for every consumer of jmap-chat-client, solely to support this one function.

Two fix options:
1. **Wrap the input**: change the signature to accept `&str` (RFC 3339), `i64` (UNIX timestamp), or `std::time::SystemTime`; convert internally. Consumers who want chrono can still pass `chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339()`.
2. **Feature-gate the helper**: put `utils.rs` behind a `display-helpers` (or similar) feature; default off so consumers who only want the JMAP wire client don't pay for chrono.

The companion `format_receipt_timestamp(dt: &UTCDate)` (no `_at` suffix) does NOT expose chrono in its signature — only `_at` does. So the public exposure is one function. Fix is small.
title: chrono::DateTime<Utc> in format_receipt_timestamp_at signature locks SemVer to chrono 0.4
